dedupe_keys.name: enerit module outcomes for the 3 pilot sites on which the module has been deployed during the hit2gap project

description: Alfio Galata and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The deposited management outputs cover Challenger in France, Nanogune in Spain and Wilanow in Poland. They include monthly consumption, annual significant energy uses and annual improvement opportunities. Fields describe measured energy, cost and carbon dioxide, proposed targets, estimated and actual savings, capital cost and payback. The source states January 2016 to August 2019 and labels it 42 months; this inconsistent duration is preserved without inventing missing months. These derived management outputs support energy-system intervention appraisal and remain distinct from the related raw meter time series. Their underlying measurements can overlap those raw collections. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cdla-permissive-1.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
